independent_2018_controls.narrative: First kilometres were easier; Vantalängan was followed by a steep climb around km 14; finish reported as roughly 22 km.

landmarks.name: Vantalängan
landmarks.independent_2018_evidence: Forsbackarunner race report places the steep climb immediately after Vantalängan at about km 14; current organizer material places the Vantalängan aid station at 13 km.

landmarks.name: Hallamölla
landmarks.independent_2018_evidence: The documented Verkeån race corridor passes Hallamölla before and after the Vantalängan section.
